name: Yozora · PMVHaven
description: 18+. PMV/HMV community videos from PMVHaven via its public keyless browse API (tags, sorting, pagination) with direct MP4 playback from the platform's own object storage. Text search needs a platform key upstream, so in-app search maps the query to a tag. No auth, DRM or paywall is bypassed.
author: Yozora
notes: 18+ streaming provider. Search = browse-by-tag (first word of the query; e.g. 'pmv', 'hmv', 'cosplay'). Videos already seen while browsing play instantly; others are located by a bounded scan of the browse API.
